erin (DevEx): quick follow-up from onboarding calls: users keep getting unhelpful SDK errors during quickstart. can we agree on a tiny, stable error shape we can rely on across Node/Python/Go?

sam (SDK): yep. show me one real payload you saw.

erin (DevEx): example from prod logs: POST /v1/chat 403
{"error":"forbidden","reason":"org_quota_exceeded","message":"quota for org 123 exceeded"}
Node SDK surfaces: Error: Request failed (403). No structured fields.

noor (sample-app): impact: quickstart shows a generic banner "Request failed" with a retry button. Users keep retrying and churn.

sam (SDK): got it. proposal (minimal): SDK errors expose: `code` (string), `status` (int), `message` (string), `hints` (string[]), `is_retryable` (bool). Keep names consistent across languages.

peter (infra): infra will add `error.code` and `error.hints` to responses. we'll default `error.code` to mapping: 400->ERR_VALIDATION, 401->ERR_AUTH, 403->ERR_PERM, 429->ERR_RATE_LIMIT, 5xx->ERR_INTERNAL. If response body contains a specific reason (quota_exceeded) we'll use a more specific code (ERR_QUOTA).

oliver (PM): +1. onboarding guidance: if `code==ERR_QUOTA` show a clear non-retryable message linking to billing/limits. If `code==ERR_AUTH` and hint includes `scope`, do NOT auto-refresh unless SDK indicates `is_retryable=true`.

sam (SDK): implementation notes:
- Add typed exceptions: AuthError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, InternalError.
- Each exception class carries `.code` (ERR_*), `.status`, `.message`, `.hints`(string[]), `.is_retryable`(bool).
- Provide helper `shouldRetry(err)` that uses `is_retryable` fallbacking to status-based defaults.

noor (sample-app): I'll change quickstart to call `shouldRetry` and show `.hints[0]` if present. I'll also avoid refresh loops by capping token refresh attempts.

sam (SDK): edge case: 429 sometimes arrives with `Retry-After: 0` or missing header. SDK logic: prefer numeric Retry-After header -> fallback to `error.retry_after` in body -> fallback to backoff util (exp backoff + jitter). Document fallback.

peter (infra): we'll start sending `retry_after` when feasible.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app/quickstart tests failing on branch fix/error-shape - 2 failing tests (suggestion rendering + retry cap).

erin (DevEx): tests: please add an integration test that simulates 403 with `{reason: \"org_quota_exceeded\"}` and asserts UI shows quota guidance and `shouldRetry` returns false. Also test 401 with `hint: token expired` (retryable) vs `hint: missing scope` (non-retryable).

sam (SDK): will add tests for Node/Python/Go. plan: land SDK changes this sprint, keep legacy behavior for one release with a deprecation warning.

oliver (PM): filing RFC for canonical error codes and migration plan. link will be posted in this thread.

erin (DevEx): small Console request: show `code`, `hints`, and `trace_id` in the error inspector so support can triage quickly.

peter (infra): adding fields to Console payload on backlog. low effort.

noor (sample-app): PR opened: #512 - quickstart reads `err.hints` and uses `shouldRetry`. Adds unit + e2e tests.

sam (SDK): PRs opened for Node/Python/Go: #913, #914, #915. includes typed errors, `is_retryable`, and migration notes.

erin (DevEx): great. follow-ups: update quickstart docs, add sample snippets showing `if (!shouldRetry(err)) showHelp()` and announce in `#devex` and `#onboarding`.

ci-bot: migration note: servers will add `error.code`; older SDKs will still parse freeform messages for one release.

oliver (PM): RFC: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/2026/error-shape-parity (draft)

erin (DevEx): thanks everyone. I'll monitor support queue for drops next week. :thumbsup:
